authorization_scope: single DATA-only exploratory execution; execution authorization is not human scientific review
design_rationale: Historical three-seed runs were development/exploratory screens. V2 prospectively uses fresh paired seeds, identical external perturbation across arms, an exact 20-tick delay check, and a same-seed perturbation-exposed closed-loop donor for the timing-shuffle control.

design.timing_shuffle_contract: For every seed, timing_shuffle consumes a deterministic permutation of the complete sensor tape produced by that seed's actual closed_loop arm under the same external perturbation.
design.delay_contract: delayed_proprioception observes its own causal sensor stream delayed by exactly 20 ticks, clamped to tick zero before the delay horizon.
design.feedback_absent_contract: Observed position and velocity are fixed to zero while the body still receives the identical external perturbation schedule.

analysis_plan.direction_convention: positive control-minus-closed_loop difference means lower error in intact closed_loop
report: fraction of paired seeds with lower closed_loop error

integrity_requirements: same initial neural state within each seed
same initial body state within each seed
same graph fingerprint within each seed
identical registered perturbation schedule for all arms
feedback_absent observed sensor values are exactly zero
delayed_proprioception observed sensor values match the exact 20-tick causal delay contract
timing_shuffle donor digest equals the actual closed_loop sensor digest for that seed
timing_shuffle observed sensor values match the deterministic registered permutation of that donor tape
stopping_rule: Execute exactly the preregistered 20 seeds and four conditions. Retain failures; no replacement seeds and no outcome-dependent stopping.
claim_boundary: This is prospective exploratory synthetic DATA for the scoped H-EMB-002-A proprioception comparison. It is not confirmatory EVID, not independent replication, not evidence of learned body schema, autonomy, consciousness, biological equivalence, real-device transfer, or 5D superiority. Human Review remains required.
